profile_text.body:
Raptor Technologies describes itself as a provider of integrated school safety software for K-12, with tools to screen visitors, track volunteers, report on drills, respond to emergencies, and reunite families. The company says its unified platform connects safety workflows so schools can prepare for, respond to, and recover from emergencies, and it offers campus intelligence tools for real-time visibility into who is on campus, training resources, and compliance management. It also describes Raptor Badge Alert, a wearable badge that lets staff activate alerts, which the company presents as cost-effective, multi-layered alerting on an end-to-end emergency management platform. The site states that its solutions serve schools, childcare programs, and youth centers, and it references a session with Lauren Smith, Volunteer Mentor Program Coordinator at Champaign Community Unit School District, about managing volunteer access.

The company is tracked as an education and research AI product, with a note that it was found in research for The AI Ready School and not independently verified, that AI features are not verified, and that its use is visitor management and emergency tools for staff. Pricing is quote only, with no published pricing, and privacy terms are not verified.

No lawsuits, MCP servers, or SEC or patent facts are recorded for the company.
